"""Regression coverage for unavailable Workday job postings."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Awaitable
from typing import Final

import pytest
from playwright.async_api import Page

import automation.scripts.eval.runner.evaluate as evaluate
from automation.scripts.eval.runner.evaluate.state import AsyncEvaluateTargetInput
from src.autopilot import FormPlanningGraph
from src.browser_runtime.page_ops.snapshot import snapshot_page_context
from src.types.typed import JsonObject, as_json_object

pytestmark = pytest.mark.integration

_WORKDAY_JOB_URL: Final = "https://acme.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/acme/job/1"
_UNAVAILABLE_BOOTSTRAP: Final = """
<main></main>
<script>
window.workday = { postingAvailable: false };
</script>
"""


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_snapshot_classifies_workday_unavailable_bootstrap(
    async_page: Page,
) -> None:
    await async_page.set_content(_UNAVAILABLE_BOOTSTRAP)

    context = await snapshot_page_context(async_page)

    assert context["non_actionable_likely"], (
        "Workday's postingAvailable=false bootstrap must be terminal page evidence"
    )
    assert context["non_actionable_reason"] == "stale_or_missing_application", (
        "an unavailable posting is stale, not a generic zero-field extraction failure"
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_eval_skips_activation_and_extraction_for_unavailable_workday(
    async_page: Page,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    calls: list[str] = []

    async def no_auth_gate(
        _inp: AsyncEvaluateTargetInput,
        _resolved: str,
    ) -> JsonObject | None:
        return None

    async def load_unavailable_posting(
        page: Page,
        _resolved: str,
        _timeout_ms: int,
    ) -> None:
        calls.append("navigate")
        await page.set_content(_UNAVAILABLE_BOOTSTRAP)

    async def reject_downstream(*_args: object, **_kwargs: object) -> None:
        raise AssertionError(
            "unavailable Workday postings must stop before apply activation or extraction"
        )

    async def summarize_non_actionable(
        _inp: AsyncEvaluateTargetInput,
        initial_ctx: JsonObject,
        _ctx: evaluate.EvalContext,
    ) -> JsonObject:
        calls.append("non_actionable")
        return as_json_object(
            {
                "pass_reason": "non_actionable_stage",
                "non_actionable_reason": initial_ctx["non_actionable_reason"],
            }
        )

    monkeypatch.setattr(evaluate, "eval_auth_gate_context", no_auth_gate)
    monkeypatch.setattr(evaluate, "navigate_to_target", load_unavailable_posting)
    monkeypatch.setattr(evaluate, "activate_apply_flow_if_needed", reject_downstream)
    monkeypatch.setattr(evaluate, "_run_page_loop", reject_downstream)
    monkeypatch.setattr(evaluate, "_handle_non_actionable", summarize_non_actionable)

    result = await evaluate.evaluate_target(
        AsyncEvaluateTargetInput(
            page=async_page,
            planner=FormPlanningGraph(),
            target=_WORKDAY_JOB_URL,
            profile_data=as_json_object({}),
            timeout_ms=1_000,
            strict_live=True,
            strict_policy="full-excluding-system",
            max_pages=1,
        )
    )

    assert calls == ["navigate", "non_actionable"], (
        "eval must classify the loaded posting before apply activation and extraction"
    )
    assert result["non_actionable_reason"] == "stale_or_missing_application", (
        "the summary must preserve the Workday unavailable-posting reason"
    )
